programs.desc: As a newly graduated engineer loses track of what's important, his career starts to rise. When he falls in love with a beautiful young woman, he gets even more confused about what he wants.

programs.title: Hum Dono
programs.desc: Raja discovers that his face is similar to that of Dr Shekhar, one of the top earning doctors of Bombay. He manages to take his place, but discovers that Dr Shekhar has many problems of his own.

programs.title: Gumrah
programs.desc: Meena, who lives with her retired and widowed father in rural Nainital, is visited by her sister, her husband and her two children. Meena speaks of her love for Rajendra, a painter and singer, and Kamla, her sister, approves of her choice. However, before Meena can make a move, Kamla passes away leaving her children in the hands of Meena.
